_comment: PasskeyRename, the form RenamePasskeyAction prompts with through a retry (generic passkeys page
PRD D4, S3), shipped by MintPlayer.Spark.Authorization. A virtual prompt type: no clrType, no
documents, no rights needed, never a page of its own. Its own type rather than PasskeyRow, whose
attributes are grid columns and read-only.
HAND-AUTHORED. The ids are UUIDv5 of 'authorization:PasskeyRename[.attributes.<Name>]' (D5),
Name is optional (an empty name shows as 'Unnamed passkey'). The maxLength rule guides the form;
the action sanitizes whatever arrives anyway (64 characters, no control characters).
